Name: Bubble Town 2
Description: A bubble shooter: fire matching orbs into the cluster above and drop what they detach.

Achievements.Name: Houston, we have a...
Achievements.Description: Defeat the Lumpress in her final state.

Achievements.Name: Rock Lob-ster!
Achievements.Description: Match any borbs using the lob cannon

Achievements.Name: Transport Traffic
Achievements.Description: Fire a borb and make a match through the whirlpool or black hole.

Achievements.Name: Bubble-licious
Achievements.Description: Detaches 14+ borbs/lumps using the plunger power up

Achievements.Name: To infinity and beyond
Achievements.Description: Awarded when the player reaches the first space level.

Achievements.Name: Soaped-Up
Achievements.Description: Awarded when player has used all the power-ups

Achievements.Name: Soap and Glory
Achievements.Description: The player must match 3 borbs after having banked off of 3 walls, with a single shot.

Achievements.Name: In It To Win It
Achievements.Description: The player must reach a score of 150,000

Achievements.Name: Take it to the Bank’
Achievements.Description: Complete any level using bank shots.

Achievements.Name: Dead Eye
Achievements.Description: Hit the eye evey time when open without missing

Achievements.Name: Canny Cannon
Achievements.Description: The player must attain a score of 15,000 inside a single level.
